title: Application
text:
Application
Find out more about the application process for INFOTECH.
Requirements
Roadmap for applying
Selection Process
Post-Acceptance Information
FAQ
Adjunct FormNeeded for your application in C@mpus can be found here.Note: Only this form should be used when applying to INFOTECH - other programs have their own forms and they are not universal.
Interested in applying? Read the 'Requirements' and 'Roadmap for applying' pages.
The INFOTECH program offers admission twice a year: in winter and summer semester.
Application periods (for all applicants) for the following:Winter semester: November 15th - January 15thSummer semester: May 15th - July 15th
The application periods are ca. 9 months before the semester begins. Winter semester begins October 1stSummer semester begins April 1stThe entire application process is conducted via the Campus Management System (C@MPUS). For issues with the application in C@MPUS please contact their support.A manual for applying via C@MPUS is available here.
The adjunct form that must be submitted with your application can be found here. (Please only use this form - not one from another program)Please note: although it is not needed to apply, you should plan to start the Visa process as soon as possible, as the process can take up to 6 months or more.
Competition for the admission to the INFOTECH program is tough, and we can only offer admission to a small percentage of the applicants we receive.Academic background and performance during the Bachelor degree are the main selection criteria. Note, the application requirements listed are the minimum needed to be considered. Nationality, gender, race, scholarships and work experiences have no influence on the selection process.
The University of Stuttgart is not in a position to award any scholarships or provide financial support.To learn more about scholarship programs in Germany, see for example the German Academic Exchange Service (DAAD) webpage or other organisations at the German Embassy in your home country. We have also collected some useful links in the Links Section of the INFOTECH Homepage.
